{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted dark plum fine-gauge merino sweater, slim crew neck, hip length, #5B2A3C, soft wool knit
High-waisted straight-leg trousers, ankle length, charcoal #36393F, wool crepe
Tailored single-breasted blazer, slightly cropped at the hip, soft navy-black #1F2430, textured wool tweed with a subtle weave
Pointed-toe ankle boots, low block heel, black #151515, smooth leather
Slim leather belt, black #151515, matte leather with a small silver buckle
Small structured shoulder bag, deep burgundy #4A1F2B, smooth leather
Delicate drop earrings and a thin chain bracelet, polished silver #C0C0C0, metal

This outfit works because the plum knit and burgundy bag add warmth and quiet depth to a restrained palette of charcoal and near-black, which suits an autumn evening. The tailored textured blazer and straight trousers give a classic, polished line that fits a neat dress band without feeling stiff. Ankle boots keep the look comfortable for a restaurant dinner while staying refined, and the understated silver jewelry adds a soft glow in artificial light without being loud."}
